blocks.text: Periodic table ke elements ko is buniyad par bhi baanta ja sakta hai ke un ke valence electrons kis subshell mein hain. Maslan pehle do groups ke elements ke valence electrons “s” subshell mein hote hain, is liye yeh elements s-block mein hain.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka khaali jaal, blocks ke rang mein: groups 1 aur 2 halka neela (s block), groups 3 se 12 period 4 se neeche hara (d block), groups 13 se 18 aur group 18 ke upar wala khaana surkh (p block), aur neeche 14 khaanon ki do alag qataarein peeli (f block).
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Periodic table ke blocks (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq original drawing; kitab mein Figure 10.2 chhapa hai).

blocks.text: Isi tarah transition elements d-block mein hain, aur table ke neeche wali do series (Lanthanides aur Actinides) f-block elements kehlati hain. Baqi elements, yani groups 13 se 18, aakhri group ki inert (noble) gases samet, p-block mein hain. Kisi element ka block jaan kar us ke bare mein bohat kuch pata chalta hai: us ki chemical reactivity, oxidation states, electronegativity, ionization energy aur electrons ke bharne ka tareeqa.

blocks.prompt: Element X group 2 mein hai aur element Y group 15 mein. Har ek ka block aur woh subshell batayein jis mein us ke valence electrons hain.
blocks.explanation: X s-block mein hai, us ke valence electrons s subshell mein hain. Y p-block mein hai, us ke valence electrons p subshell mein hain.

items: s-block: groups 1 aur 2; p-block: groups 13 se 18; d-block: transition elements; f-block: lanthanides aur actinides.
Block se reactivity, oxidation states, electronegativity, ionization energy aur electron filling ka andaza hota hai.
